summary: Check-Cap Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of an underwritten public offering of 1,538,462 ordinary shares at $6.50 per share, raising approximately $10.0 million in gross proceeds. Northland Securities acted as sole book-running manager and representative of the underwriters. The offering was made under an effective Form F-1 registration statement, and insiders entered into 180-day lock-up agreements. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for post-offering share price performance and potential share overhang after the lock-up expires.
